explanation.headline: Magnesium sulfate is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 27.5 days on hand and Corvale General has 17.6 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows magnesium sulfate is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 336 bags of the 40 mg/mL 50 mL presentation with daily use of 12.2 bags, providing 27.5 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 235 bags of the same presentation with daily use of 13.4 bags, providing 17.6 days on hand.
A secondary option is to buy from Civica, Inc., supplied from Baxter Healthcare Corporation Deerfield.
A third option is to buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, supplied from HP Halden Pharma AS, last inspected VAI on 2023-05-10.

rejected.text: The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from B. Braun Medical Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.
rejected.reason: Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
